definition.circular_null: circularly shift all detections by one random offset per video
definition.local_increase_percentile: percentile rank of the largest increase within +/-0.5 seconds of the human timestamp
definition.peak: maximum centered 0.25-second rigidity deviation after frame 0
definition.stratified_shuffle_null: shuffle detector candidate sets among events with the same dataset and component
definition.surge: largest increase in centered 0.25-second mean over the preceding 0.25 seconds
definition.top2_surge: nearest of the two largest increases separated by at least 0.25 seconds

timestamp_curation_notes: COSMOS2.5_0002 says 'minor deform at sec1' without assigning that time to a component; the structured component and prose anatomy also conflict, so it is excluded.
LVP_ROBOWM_0031 has an upper-arm structured label but says forearm deformation at sec1; it is excluded from component-matched localization.
COSMOS3_0014 contains an ambiguous second value written as 05; only the unambiguous gripper event at 1 s is used.
COSMOS2.5_0047 says deformation at sec0 and sec1 without ordering the forearm and gripper events; both are represented by the interval midpoint 0.5 s.
Second-half-of-sec0 annotations are represented by 0.75 s. Start-of-secN is represented by N seconds, and end-of-sec1 is represented by 2 seconds.
